answer: Rotating pulse muster. Each identity must answer a randomized challenge at unpredictable intervals, maintaining a grove of live session threads whose continuity is checked. Missed musters decay accumulated standing, and standing gates access to high-value actions. Attackers pay sustained attention per clone—real operator hours, not one-time fees—while a sable cover of idle fakes is pruned by the same decay, making mass impersonation linearly costly in labor.
